1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe in an OFDM network, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel __operable to carry system information__, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier, and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __operable to carry quick page and control information, wherein the first set of subcarriers and the second set of subcarriers are allocated in a manner that enables simultaneous transmission of both the first broadcast channel and the second broadcast channel on the first symbol__.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is distinct from the distribution pattern of the second set of subcarriers__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a complementary pattern to the first set of subcarriers__.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and control information, __wherein the superframe preamble further comprises a second one of the symbols allocating substantially all the subcarriers to the second broadcast channel__.

7. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 6, further comprising setting a change indicator in the superframe preamble to indicate whether the system information for a subsequent superframe group has changed with respect to a previous superframe group, __wherein the change indicator is encoded in the second broadcast channel and is decodable by a subscriber station to determine whether to decode the system information__.

8. (Original)

10. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 7, the change indicator comprising a single bit in the control information __of the second broadcast channel__.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel __operable to carry system information__, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __operable to carry quick page and control information, wherein the first set of subcarriers and the second set of subcarriers are allocated in a manner that enables simultaneous transmission of both the first broadcast channel and the second broadcast channel on the first symbol__.

20. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

21. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is distinct from the distribution pattern of the second set of subcarriers__.

22. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and other control information, __wherein the preamble generator is further operable to allocate substantially all the subcarriers to the second broadcast channel for a second one of the symbols__.

23. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 22, the preamble generator further operable to set a change indicator in the superframe preamble to indicate whether the system information for a superframe group comprising the superframe has changed with respect to a previous superframe group, __wherein the change indicator is encoded in the second broadcast channel and is decodable by a subscriber station to determine whether to decode the system information__.
